description: NIX is the imaging arm of ERIS, the Enhanced Resolution Imager and Spectrograph on VLT UT4. It images from J through M, with coronagraphy from K through M and long-slit spectroscopy in L. These are the filters in ESO's nix-filters.zip.
facility_description: ERIS is mounted at the Cassegrain focus of UT4 at the ESO VLT and uses the Adaptive Optics Facility.
notes: ESO asks authors to cite Davies et al. 2023, A&A 674, 207. The zip headers name the parent text files and say the tables were written by cleantrim.pro; they do not label the wavelength unit. Sample ranges above assume metres. NJM also has a Ks band. The zip contains filter_K.dat, whose samples run from 1.859e-6 to 2.488e-6, and no file named Ks, so Ks is not given its own entry. research_bands.tsv listed seven NIX bands; the live info.json has no SVO match for any of the 17, so the unambiguous zip members are all included.

Br-a.Comments: The zip member is named Br-a. The sampled column runs from 3.986e-6 to 4.114e-6, which is 3.986–4.114 μm if that column is metres. The header does not label the unit. The quoted span is the range of samples in the file, not a measured FWHM.
